jobs.brief: Character sprite for a macOS desktop companion app. Reference 1 is the character and the exact rendering to match: the same bunny, same proportions, same soft matte clay look and lighting, drawn at the same size in the frame with its feet on the same baseline. Reference 2 is an older, lower-quality rendering of the same bunny that shows the pose to copy; copy only its pose, not its quality, colors or edges. Style: soft matte clay 3D render, gentle studio lighting from the upper left, smooth surfaces, cute and calm. Pose: standing, raising one hand that holds up a small white card with a bold orange exclamation mark, alert and attentive. Full body, square image. The background must be truly transparent (a real alpha channel, not a painted checkerboard or any color), with clean anti-aliased edges. No ground, no shadow, no outline, no text, no watermark.

Edit reference 1: keep everything identical (same bunny, same pose, same position and size in the frame, same lighting and framing) and change only the eyes, which are gently closed mid-blink as soft curved lines. Full body, square image, fully transparent background with clean anti-aliased edges, no ground, no shadow, no outline, no text, no watermark.
